description: Replay of 20 trained angle re-uploading classifiers from the Fourier geometry-selection study (4 datasets x 5 seeds) as LazyQC inference batches. Trained weights, splits and predictions come from that study; nothing is retrained here.
readout: Z_i and Z_i Z_{i+1 mod 8} on 8 wires
setup_timing: setup (planning or Qulacs circuit construction) and collection are both timed in every repetition, because each inference batch brings new data. Revised after a first run timed setup once per case, which charged a cold first call to direct Qulacs at batch size 1.
validation: LazyQC full-plan values on every test example against the matrix-free NumPy oracle, absolute tolerance 1e-10
argmax of the trained linear head on LazyQC features against the study's saved test predictions
expectation_before_timing: 4 uploads with a CX ring saturate every output cone, so this is a trained saturated-cone control; auto should keep the full plan
